# Complete confirmed shared production composition gaps
Single scene shared writer only. Coordinator starts after the existing
WO-RUST-DECODE-PUBLICATION-CONTRACTS-01 R2 writer is terminal AND independently
reviewed, main checked, accepted. Seed that exact current accepted source/tests,
never pending code. Preserve every accepted135scene assertion/literal if that
gate reaches135, otherwise its actual accepted count; original36path,31frame,
26paint proofs and source603/157oracles remain intact.

## Cumulative text commands with request cleanup
Original shape/text.c counts every run including cached layout reuse against
4Mi document text commands, separate262144cache command count. Implement actual
public source/job-owned cumulative budget, usable by MEDIA without mutating
TextState literals or using cache admission as document use. Request begin/
commit/rollback/abort include its logical counter with checked overflow and
original error/source offsets; nested child/context semantics match actual
original builder ownership. Failed provider/publication cannot spend successful
logical command admission, while physical/work history remains honest. Prove
16cached262144command uses accepted and17th rejects with no partial changes;
real successful/failed media request integration capability, no unboundedcounter
or preflight-only counting. Preserve exact original caps/error priority.

## Safe read-cache/write-scratch same-job composition
JobDashView immutably borrows all RasterJob and full validation consumes stroke
work. Scalar rows must read validated dash/grid caches while writing disjoint
same-job scratch/fill/rows/output. Implement publicly consumable safe scoped
read-cache and write-buffer interface or equivalent owning architecture; actual
same job ChargeLedger, no selfrefs/unsafe/cache cloning/new per-row allocation,
no full cache revalidation per sample disguised as equivalent work. No public
unchecked mutable Vec/lease escape. Alias/wrong/stale/pool/source guards preserve
cache data and budgets. Panic/cancel/error cleanup restores ownership honestly,
including discarded descriptors and bounded nested metadata. Cache-release,
release_all/finish/teardown cannot invalidate borrowed reads. Actual callback/
engine fixture reads grids repeatedly and writes admitted rows/output, exact
validation work once plus original per-sample work only; stale/alias/cancel/
overlap/native allocation failure tests, alloriginallocal caps retained. Existing
legacy controlled interfaces/literals remain compatible explicitly; production
cannot silently fall back to unmetered paint or copied standalone caches.

## Original post-close subpath metadata compatibility
Original shape/test_shape.c requires M1 1 C2 2 3 3 4 4 Z S6 6 7 7 equivalent
explicit cubic success. Originalshape_path.c records closed subpath and, after
later command, an extended overlapping record with samefirstedge. Accepted
Rust path parser preserves it, but currentSceneBuilder validators reject overlap.
Reconcile BOTH append validation and sealed/frame validation against actual
canonical original topology/segments. Preserve exact parser/source/geometry/
segment/subpath metadata; do not rewrite/drop/reparse entire source or blanket
allow arbitrary malformed ranges. Accept only the original canonical post-close
layout with proof from bounded segment/command data as needed; continue to reject
invalid/out-of-shape/arithmetic/foreign/inconsistent metadata, original strict
assertions unchanged. Prove implicit/explicit smooth afterZ, repeated closes/
multiple subpaths, transform and offset publication, actualfreeze/frame paths,
meaningful forged/bad-overlap and cancellation cases. Originaldecoder assertion
stays byte intact and must pass after accepted seeding; no weaker expected error.

## Mask targets and honest decode quantum
Typed production mask postoperation must carry actual source-coherent group/
shape-range target and validate it before publication; no guessing currentgroup
or fake shape, original group mask ownership preserved. Existing fixtures/post
literals additive compatibility. Nonempty child mask plan fixture applies to the
intended actual group/range and rejects stale/foreign/wrongscope/postkind/cancel.
For real synchronous shared atomic APIs, provide complete accepted quantum
semantics: either resumable source-only state without selfreference/reparse or
explicit bounded atomic operation contract crossing a requested quantum. Keep
ALL actual charged work visible and propagate cancel/error; no fake progress
(one token while whole subtree is scanned), loss of state, strict hard guarantee
without proof or arbitrary reduced SVG/capacity limits. Document precisely max
atomic scope, accumulated work, resume/failure behavior and worker-thread/main
thread use obligations. Target large-file responsiveness remains required and
unproven until measured; no performanceclaim from source API tests. Actual public
fixtures exercise style/reference/append/commit boundary accounting and show
reported work including overshoot rather than fabricated yields.

Full actual shared gap closure with usableengine examples and exact remaining

# Coordinator correction: owner anchor and definition are different roles

The equality finding was overbroad. The frozen accepted mask test at
rust/crates/vexel-scene/tests/render_integration_contracts.rs:588-616 uses
a group lexical owner but dispatches its child path, and must still pass.
The actual decoder definition_work.rs:95-100 mints the typed owner from host
(or current element), then lines129-137 dispatches the separately resolved
definition. Pattern/clip/filter URLs likewise can reference a different element.
DefinitionOwner.element is therefore a canonical planning/target anchor, not
universally the resolved definition ID. Both must be independently canonical
and source/draft/target-coherent, with returned descriptor bound to requested
definition and mapped source bound to actual owning shape as already validated.
Blanket equality changes valid behavior; neither original tests nor original
source should change to satisfy it. R2 new equality-only assertions encode that
wrong rule and must be replaced by correct role tests. No frozen assertion changes.
